Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1304
Claimant:
Jessica Mueller
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
5-8-25
Claim received by phone from the policyholder's driver regarding a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection.
Claimant reports neck and head pain and states they were struck while stopped at a red light. Claimant is
unrepresented and was given the standard claims packet.
5-29-25
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Police report obtained,
which lists the claimant as a passenger-side occupant of the vehicle that was struck from behind.
7-19-25
Statements taken from two independent witnesses and the other driver. All three describe the impact the same way
the claimant did. Scene photos received and reviewed; rear bumper and trunk damage appears consistent with the
reported force of impact.
8-17-25
Claimant was diagnosed with a concussion at urgent care the day after the collision. The diagnosis is reasonable for
a collision of this type. Medical records show no prior injruy to the head or neck area on file.
10-11-25
Claimant added a few smaller details in a follow-up call, such as the exact position of the other car before impact. The
core account has not changed from the first report. Vehicle history checked; no prior damage claims on record.
10-23-25
A neighbor mentioned seeing the vehicle with body damage seevral weeks before the stated loss date. This is an
unverified recollection and is being noted for follow-up. Treatment has followed a typical course and tapered as the
claimant improved; the file remains open pending the final medical update.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
